messages:
chloe: Quick idea 
Can we do a 'MicroSpark' sticker + mini-card desk drop next Thurs? small, low-cost surprise to boost morale.
rahul: Love it. How many recipients and what's the turnaround?
sasha: Ops can pack and label if we have a manifest. Mailroom prefers 48hr lead.
mailroom-bot: Reminder: internal drop manifest required 48 hours before scheduled delivery.
chloe: Targeting ~150 people in SF. Budget estimate: stickers $40, printed cards $30, stamps/envelope supplies $10, packing supplies $15 = ~$95.
finance: That budget is fine under Culture small spends. Use code EVENTS_SMALL. Attach receipts.
rahul: Volunteer ask: 3 people for a 60-min stuffing session Tue evening and 2 people for Wed morning handoff. Who's in?
sasha: I can do Tue evening and Wed morning. Will reserve a table and printer.
chloe: I'll draft two short message copy options and post here for a quick vote. Also propose an opt-out link in #general.
rahul: Also add a QR on the card linking to the recognition nomination form for follow-ups. I'll generate it.
mailroom-bot: ACTION: confirm final recipient list by Tue 5pm to schedule Thur drop.
chloe: Great. Checklist: recipient manifest (rahul), card copy (chloe), print order (sasha), stuffing volunteers (chloe/sasha/rahul). Will post the signup in 10. :sparkles:
